items.answer: Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid time off per year, accruing progressively throughout the year [HR-POL-002 §4.1 Annual entitlement].

citations.snippet:
Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid time off each year.

Entitlement accrues progressively across the year and is recorded in the employee's paid-time-off balance.

An employee must not represent projected future accrual as currently available leave unless the manager and People and Culture approve an advance arrangement.
citations.title: Paid Time Off Policy

citations.snippet:
- **HR-POL-002 Paid Time Off Policy** - planned paid annual leave.
- **HR-POL-003 Public Holidays Policy** - public holidays during an absence.
- **HR-POL-011 Workplace Conduct Policy** - respectful handling and non-retaliation.
- **HR-POL-013 HR Requests and Case Management Procedure** - case escalation and support.
citations.title: Leave and Absence Policy

citations.snippet: This policy applies to full-time and part-time employees, including employees in probation. Contractors do not accrue paid time off unless a written contract expressly provides an equivalent benefit.
citations.title: Paid Time Off Policy

citations.snippet:
A public holiday that falls within approved paid time off is not deducted from the paid-time-off balance when it is
a recognised holiday for the employee’s assigned location and ordinary work schedule. The leave record should
be adjusted to separate the public holiday from paid time off.
citations.title: Public Holidays Policy

citations.snippet:
• HR-POL-002 Paid Time Off Policy - interaction between public holidays and paid time off.
• HR-POL-004 Remote and Flexible Work Policy - temporary and permanent work-location arrangements.
• HR-POL-010 Leave and Absence Policy - other leave categories.
citations.title: Public Holidays Policy
